review_scope: Bounded primary-source screen for Thai palm-oil-mill cradle-to-gate GHG and allocation context; no import into the current FAME inventory

source.citation: Kaewmai, R.; H-Kittikun, A.; Musikavong, C. (2012). Greenhouse gas emissions of palm oil mills in Thailand. International Journal of Greenhouse Gas Control, 11, 141-151.
accessed_material: publisher-indexed excerpts for the goal/system-boundary, wet-extraction-process, and conclusion sections
source.data_period_note: The abstract uses Thai national CPO production in 2009 in a national total calculation, but the accessible abstract does not establish the measurement period of all 14 mill observations or allocated intensity values.
source.geography: Thailand; 14 wet-extraction palm oil mills representing 34.6% of national CPO production capacity according to the abstract
source.process_boundary: Cradle-to-gate, from FFB acquisition to CPO production, as reported by the publisher-indexed article text
source.fu: metric ton CPO (as the denominator for reported kg CO2-equivalent intensity)
locators: publisher-indexed section snippet: Goal and system boundary of research
publisher-indexed section snippet: Wet extraction process

reported_facts.name: 14-mill average GHG intensity without allocation
reported_facts.scope_note: Cradle-to-gate wet-extraction CPO result; not direct methane mass or a FAME product result

reported_facts.name: Energy-allocated intensity, mills with biogas capture
reported_facts.scope_note: Allocation share and underlying mill-period data not confirmed from full methods/tables

reported_facts.name: Energy-allocated intensity, mills without biogas capture
reported_facts.scope_note: Allocation share and underlying mill-period data not confirmed from full methods/tables

reported_facts.name: Energy-allocated Thailand average
reported_facts.scope_note: Not assumed to be a 2019/2020 provider-matched value

reported_facts.name: Energy-allocated best-observed scenario
reported_facts.scope_note: Scenario benchmark; not assumed to represent the current selected mill

reported_facts.name: Estimated total emissions from Thai wet-extraction CPO production in 2009
reported_facts.scope_note: National estimate from reported national CPO production context; not an observed plant-level output or inventory exchange

limitations: The accessible publisher abstract does not expose allocation equations or allocation shares; do not infer them from the four allocated results.
The period represented by the 14-mill mean is not established by accessible text. The national 2009 total does not prove the mill observation period.
CO2e intensities are not methane-mass measurements, COD removal, or methane capture/slip data.
The CPO cradle-to-gate boundary does not cover the team's complete FAME chain, downstream distribution/use, or end-of-life.
Provider, site, vintage, product, and foreground data do not match the selected Mill 1 / 2019-2020 FAME scenario.

decision.use: Private context-only historical Thai CPO mill benchmark for boundary and allocation discussion
decision.reason: Publisher abstract supports source-reported benchmark only; full methods/tables, matched current provider/time, and redistribution permission have not been verified.

next_evidence_needed: Full text with method/table audit for allocation equations, GWP assumptions, and the observation period of the 14 mills
Provider-matched methane mass plus actual CPO output from the same selected mill and reporting period
Current foreground chain allocation basis and coproduct fate, including confirmation no allocation was already applied
Explicit reuse/redistribution license before reproducing table content in public output
